name: image
title: Image
description: An image with required alt text, a ratio, and a fallback when it fails to load.
a11y: alt is required; use alt="" only for purely decorative images.
The fallback shows the alt text so the content is not lost when loading fails.

props.name: alt
props.description: Required. Describe the image, or pass "" if it is decorative.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width / height, for example `16 / 9`. Reserves space so the page does not jump.

props.name: fit
props.description: How the image fills its box when `ratio` crops it: `cover` (default) or `contain`.
